xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3634: Planning auto-handoff stamps the ambient flywheelRunId on operator-started work agents, stripping their reaping exemption

plan.title: Planning auto-handoff stamps the ambient flywheelRunId on operator-started work agents, stripping their reaping exemption
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every spawn stamps flywheelRunId from getFlywheelActiveRunId(), which reads the dead flywheel.active_run_id setting (stale RUN-92 on the operator's host). The emergency brake and the governor shed treat any flywheelRunId as Flywheel-dispatched, so the operator-started exemption exempts nobody. The Flywheel's own pan start calls resolve operator:cli:pan-start, and the planning auto-handoff always sends planning-auto-handoff, so no correct Flywheel provenance exists today.
narratives.Proposal: Make startedBy the one provenance signal. The conv-flywheel shell mints flywheel:conv-flywheel (resolveCliStartedBy reads OVERDECK_CONVERSATION after any inherited OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY). Delete the run-id spawn plumbing and getFlywheelActiveRunId. The reaping filters stop only agents whose startedBy starts with flywheel:. The planning auto-handoff and its deferred retry send flywheel:conv-flywheel only when the planning session was Flywheel-started, otherwise the unchanged planning-auto-handoff (keeps the consent claim). The dashboard validator accepts the new token. Docs state the rule.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Removing flywheelRunId from packages/contracts, event reducers, agent-state-read.ts or the agents table
- Removing activeRunId from the FlywheelRuntime resolver interface or deleting flywheel.active_run_id rows from existing databases
- Adding an originStartedBy / chain-origin field to agent state
- Changing the consent claim, spawn guardrails, isOperatorStartedBy, or which non-Flywheel origins the exemption covers
- Exporting OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY from the conversation launcher or changing how conv-flywheel is spawned
- Migrating or rewriting startedBy on agent state already on disk
- Changing the /pan-flywheel skill or the pan start launch path

autoDecisions.summary: Flywheel provenance is the 'flywheel:' prefix on startedBy; the conv-flywheel shell mints 'flywheel:conv-flywheel'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue author's 2026-09-26 comment says to derive provenance from startedBy or the conv-flywheel spawner; run ids no longer exist, and OVERDECK_CONVERSATION=conv-flywheel is already exported into the Flywheel's shell.

autoDecisions.summary: The exemption rule is 'reapable iff isFlywheelStartedBy(startedBy)', not 'exempt iff isOperatorStartedBy'.
autoDecisions.rationale: Preserves PAN-1812 intent (everything the Flywheel did not dispatch is exempt) and keeps planning-auto-handoff children of operator chains exempt, which is the bug being fixed.

autoDecisions.summary: The auto-handoff sends the Flywheel token only for Flywheel chains and keeps 'planning-auto-handoff' otherwise, instead of copying the planning session's startedBy verbatim.
autoDecisions.rationale: Copying 'operator:cli:pan-start' would make isOperatorStartedBy true and skip the auto-spawn consent claim, violating the issue's AC3 (auto-handoff behavior otherwise unchanged).

autoDecisions.summary: Issue AC2 ('keeps its flywheelRunId on both halves') is restated as 'carries flywheel: provenance in both planning and work state and is reapable'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The author's later comment retires run ids; the comment is the tiebreaker between the body and the comment.

autoDecisions.summary: The persisted flywheelRunId field and the FlywheelRuntime.activeRunId interface member stay as inert legacy data.
autoDecisions.rationale: Historical events carry the field and the no-loss audit tests enumerate it; removing it is a contracts change outside this issue's scope.

autoDecisions.summary: resolveCliStartedBy precedence is inherited OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY, then OVERDECK_CONVERSATION=conv-flywheel, then the default.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every server-side detached pan start sets OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY, so a server that inherits OVERDECK_CONVERSATION cannot mislabel its spawns.

autoDecisions.summary: The dashboard validator keeps accepting legacy 'flywheel:RUN-<n>' tokens.
autoDecisions.rationale: Panes launched before this change may still carry that token in OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/lib/agents/provenance.ts import FLYWHEEL_CONVERSATION_SESSION from ../flywheel/constants.js; export FLYWHEEL_STARTED_BY = `flywheel:${FLYWHEEL_CONVERSATION_SESSION}` and PLANNING_AUTO_HANDOFF_STARTED_BY = 'planning-auto-handoff'; add isFlywheelStartedBy(startedBy) (trimmed value starts with 'flywheel:') and planningHandoffStartedBy(planningStartedBy) (Flywheel -> FLYWHEEL_STARTED_BY, anything else -> 'planning-auto-handoff'). In resolveCliStartedBy replace the OVERDECK_FLYWHEEL_RUN_ID branch: inherited OVERDECK_AGENT_STARTED_BY first, then OVERDECK_CONVERSATION (trimmed) === 'conv-flywheel' -> FLYWHEEL_STARTED_BY, else defaultOrigin. Keep normalizeFlywheelRunId exported. Update/add the tests listed in PRD WI-1.
